HB-ACC-001.query: SELECT username,uid FROM users WHERE uid=0 AND username!='root';

HB-ACC-002.query: SELECT username FROM shadow WHERE password_status='not_set';

HB-ACC-003.query: SELECT username,max FROM shadow WHERE max>90 AND username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM users WHERE shell LIKE '%nologin' OR shell='/bin/false');
HB-ACC-003.description: 账户口令最长使用期限核查

HB-ACC-004.query: SELECT username,shell FROM users WHERE uid<1000 AND uid!=0 AND shell NOT LIKE '%nologin' AND shell!='/bin/false' AND shell!='/sbin/nologin';
HB-ACC-004.description: 系统账户登录 shell 限制核查

HB-ACC-005.query: SELECT rule_details FROM sudoers WHERE rule_details LIKE '%NOPASSWD%';

HB-NET-001.query: SELECT DISTINCT address,port FROM listening_ports WHERE port IN (23,512,513,514,21);
HB-NET-001.description: Telnet 等高危明文端口暴露核查

HB-NET-002.query: SELECT name,path FROM processes WHERE name IN ('telnetd','in.telnetd','rshd','in.rshd','rlogind','vsftpd','in.tftpd');
HB-NET-002.description: 明文传输服务进程核查

HB-NET-003.query: SELECT current_value FROM system_controls WHERE name='net.ipv4.ip_forward';
HB-NET-003.description: IP 转发关闭核查（非路由主机）

HB-NET-004.description: ICMP 重定向报文禁用核查

HB-MAC-001.query: SELECT current_value FROM selinux_settings WHERE key='mode';

HB-FW-001.query: SELECT chain,policy FROM iptables WHERE chain='INPUT';

HB-FILE-001.query: SELECT path,mode FROM file WHERE path='/etc/shadow' AND mode NOT IN ('0000','0400','0600','0640');

HB-FILE-002.query: SELECT path,permissions FROM suid_bin WHERE path NOT IN (SELECT path FROM suid_bin WHERE path LIKE '/usr/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/usr/sbin/%' OR path LIKE '/sbin/%');
HB-FILE-002.description: SUID/SGID 异常提权文件核查

HB-FILE-003.query: SELECT path,mode FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/etc/%' OR path LIKE '/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/sbin/%') AND mode LIKE '%7' AND type='regular';
HB-FILE-003.description: 系统目录全局可写文件核查

HB-PER-001.query: SELECT command,path FROM crontab WHERE command LIKE '%curl%' OR command LIKE '%wget%' OR command LIKE '%/tmp/%' OR command LIKE '%base64%' OR command LIKE '%nc %';

HB-SYS-001.description: 操作系统版本生命周期（EOL）核查

HB-TIME-001.query: SELECT name FROM processes WHERE name IN ('chronyd','ntpd');
HB-TIME-001.description: 时间同步服务运行核查

HB-NET-005.query: SELECT address,hostnames FROM etc_hosts WHERE address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1','::1','127.0.1.1');
